status: PRELIMINARY DETAIL DEVELOPMENT — NOT FOR FABRICATION
completed_scope: Custom integral-collar sliding pins with guided travel, internal parking grooves, physically fastened endcaps and direct far-tip witness markings.
Actual manufacturer GN1024 spring-cotter solids at lock and hinge shafts; lock cotters physically park on fixed studs during motion.
Front U-handholds, attached cheek covers, stand-offs and fasteners, rear sheet clamps, internal threaded backers and a 12 in constant-length rear curtain family.
Tether anchor tabs, parked-cotter studs, open-top routing saddles and closed slotted slack trays with attached lids; prescribed cable routes in each explicit state.
Revised two-foot foundation, gussets and nominal weld preparation/bead envelopes; eight unique underframe collars, 12 revised rail-fit envelopes and full-depth flush steel floor transitions.
Three explicit nominal solids/mesh states; 19 complete folding samples; 19 pin withdrawal/turn samples; 16 socket envelope checks; source-driven drawing sheets; compressed STEP handoff.
unfinished: The complete assembly has a 19-angle sampled interference check, not a continuous swept-volume proof. Only the circular sector arc has the stated analytic post-clearance bound.
Installed elastic spring-cotter envelope and retention proof; cable and rear-curtain flexibility, snag/vibration behavior and complete physical finger-probe protection tests.
Supplier-defined cable loop/swage manufacture and strength. Rounded cable CAD is a prescribed clearance envelope, not a wire-rope bending simulation.
Pin, clevis and bushing finished fits; tolerance stacks, corrosion/wear, lubrication and material/heat-treatment certification.
Weld procedure/penetration, fatigue/proof loads, guide/endcap screw process, bolt torque-tension qualification and inspection procedures.
Seat/back upholstery production retention, finished edge radii/coatings/fire performance and crew/glove/reach mockup.
Full coach/truck integration, all service/dynamic loads and jurisdiction-specific engineering approval.

checks.expected_elastic_contacts: Each OEM cotter/own-shaft and cable termination pair is enumerated explicitly; these do not establish an installed elastic envelope.

independent_reviews.bound_scope: Circular sector arc only; tang, other rigid parts and flexible components are not covered by this analytic bound.
independent_reviews.pin_capture: Independent geometric probes show no nominal interference at engaged, withdrawn or parked positions; +/-0.01 in travel produces collar interference at retaining shoulders. This is not a strength test.

mass.included: Nominal metals/hardware/curtain/cable/welds; actual coatings, upholstery retention and final certified hardware may differ
mass.allocation_note: Includes modeled padding and allocated collar, floor transition, weld and seal mass once. Existing underframe mass is context; final upholstery hardware, coatings and procurement tolerances are not fully modeled.

composition: Hide the prototype context/floor inspection groups when combining two translated seat instances with the single global foundation model. Count global collar geometry once.

drawings.title: Captive pin, retained hinge and operating grip
Attached guards, rear curtain and tether routing
Seat hardpoints, rail collars and flush floor transitions
